title: Branch A — early bronchoscopy consequence
openingNarrative: Early bronchoscopy removes a distal mucus plug in sections. Right chest movement improves. Brief hypotension occurs. No arrest. The team names the blood-pressure dip without moralising. Rohan’s scanning access stays active through recovery positioning. Uncertainty remains: whether inflammation will re-accumulate secretions overnight.
clinicalState: Distal plug cleared. Improved right aeration. Transient hypotension resolved without CPR. Cardiac monitoring continues. Infection treatment trade-off from earlier still active.

choices.label: Document the hypotension, keep AAC access, move to sedation review planning
choices.immediateConsequence: Observable change: lower peak pressures and better right air entry. Team communication stays factual. Rohan’s access status: auditory scanning available.
choices.delayedConsequence: Uncertainty that remains: re-plugging risk and renal–infection balance. Transition into sedation reduction and delirium prevention without declaring a winning strategy.
choices.rohanAacLine: THE RESUSCITATION BAY GOT THE PULSE BACK.
